intro: Extended thinking gives Claude a private scratchpad to reason deeply before answering. It dramatically improves quality for hard, multi-step problems.

sections.title: When to Use It
rows: Complex refactors with many moving parts
Tasks where speed matters more than depth

items.title: Simple trigger
items.body: "Think carefully about the best approach before writing any code." or "Before answering, reason through all the tradeoffs and edge cases."

items.title: Directed trigger
items.body: "Before recommending an architecture, think through: 1. What happens at 10x load? 2. What are the failure modes? 3. What's the operational complexity?"

items.title: Multiple options
items.body: "Reason through three different approaches, evaluate each, then recommend the best with a clear rationale."
